description: A little space for extraordinary discoveries.
summary:
ORBITOYS is a creative storytelling experience that brings real space exploration machines to life by presenting them as collectible toys in a fictional toy shop.

Created for school age learners and casual space enthusiasts, the project offers a fun and approachable way to discover the machines left behind during space missions. It uses the Lunar Roving Vehicle from NASA's Apollo 15 mission as its first featured machine, introducing its purpose, history and role in lunar exploration.

By turning real space hardware into characters with stories to tell, ORBITOYS aims to make space history more engaging, memorable and easier to explore.
details:
ORBITOYS uses the idea of a toy shop to make real space exploration machines more interesting and approachable. Each machine is presented as a collectible toy with its own story, helping players connect with the history behind the hardware.

The first featured machine is NASA's Lunar Roving Vehicle, used during the Apollo 15 mission in 1971. Through its story and visual presentation, players can learn what the rover was designed to do, how it helped astronauts explore the Moon and why it was important to the mission.

The project is designed to make learning about space hardware feel less like reading a history lesson and more like discovering something interesting through play.

The project uses NASA's Lunar Roving Vehicle information and historical resources as its factual foundation. Creative storytelling and visual elements help present this information in a way that is accessible to school age learners and casual space enthusiasts.

Tools used includes Figma, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Google Flow Music
